toegepas.voor: Keer op keer gryp sy na die water en haar pote bly leeg.
toegepas.na: Keer op keer gryp sy na die water, en haar pote bly leeg.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects and verbs (sy gryp / haar pote bly).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb (sy gryp / haar pote bly).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation only, required by the AWS 2017; nothing in the story changes.

toegepas.voor: 'n boodskap stuur. Soos ek sterf en weer terugkom, so sal julle ook terugkom.
toegepas.na: 'n boodskap stuur: “Soos ek sterf en weer terugkom, so sal julle ook terugkom.”
toegepas.rede_vinder: The Moon's message stands as an unmarked sentence, so 'ek' and 'julle' seem to come from nowhere; a colon and quotation marks show it is the message.
toegepas.fout: The Moon's message stands as a bare sentence, so 'ek' and 'julle' arrive unannounced and a Grade 4 reader stumbles.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Colon and quotation marks only mark the existing words as the message; same words, same events.

toegepas.voor: maar die haas vat dit by hom
toegepas.na: maar die haas vat dit by die insek
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hom' could point to the Moon or the insect; the hare takes the message from the insect.
toegepas.fout: 'by hom' can point to the Moon or to the insect.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the insect resolves the pronoun without changing who does what; the hare takes the message from the insect it was given to.

toegepas.voor: sê dit verkeerd. Soos ek sterf en nie terugkom nie, so sal julle ook nie.
toegepas.na: sê dit verkeerd: “Soos ek sterf en nie terugkom nie, so sal julle ook nie terugkom nie.”
toegepas.rede_vinder: Mark the hare's wrong message as speech, and complete the clause so it mirrors the Moon's message and reads clearly for Grade 4.
toegepas.fout: The hare's false message is unmarked speech and its elliptic ending 'ook nie' is harder to follow than the Moon's full sentence it mirrors.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Quotation marks match change 2 and 'terugkom nie' only spells out what the ellipsis already said; no new content.

toegepas.voor: Die Maan slaan die haas se lip oop en dit is
toegepas.na: Die Maan slaan die haas se lip oop, en dit is
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: two sentences with their own subjects and verbs joined by 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses (Die Maan slaan / dit is).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation only, required by the AWS 2017.

toegepas.voor: Nag na nag word hy groter en op die ou end
toegepas.na: Nag na nag word hy groter, en op die ou end
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects and verbs (word hy / is hy).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses (word hy / is hy).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation only, required by the AWS 2017.

toegepas.voor: Hulle het eendag met mekaar baklei
toegepas.na: Die twee het eendag met mekaar baklei
toegepas.rede_vinder: Straight after 'By hulle word vertel' (the Maasai), 'Hulle' can read as the Maasai people fighting.
toegepas.fout: 'Hulle' directly follows 'By hulle word vertel', where 'hulle' meant the Maasai, so the same pronoun could point to two groups.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die twee' is natural and unambiguously the Sun and Moon; same people, same action.

laat_vaar.voor: sny nag na nag stukke van hom af
laat_vaar.na: sny nag na nag stukke van die Maan af
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The subject is the Son, so 'van hom af' can read as the Sun cutting pieces off itself.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: In a paragraph about the Moon, 'van hom af' with the Sun as subject reads naturally as the Moon, and the proposal puts 'die Maan' in three sentences running.

laat_vaar.voor: om hom te los ter wille van sy kinders
laat_vaar.na: om hom ter wille van sy kinders te los
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In standard Afrikaans the infinitive 'te los' stands at the end of the clause.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing 'ter wille van sy kinders' after the infinitive is normal Afrikaans and keeps the story's rhythm; the proposal is a lateral reorder.

laat_vaar.voor: dat niemand na hom kan kyk nie
laat_vaar.na: dat niemand meer na hom kan kyk nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Past 'het begin skyn' followed by present 'kan' jars; 'meer' keeps the still-true present reading while linking it to the moment he started shining.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Present 'kan' deliberately carries the still-true outcome, as 'vandag nog' does in the next lines, while 'meer' adds a claim that people could look at him before.

na_skrywer.voor: Die haas krap na die Maan se gesig en daardie merke is nog daar.
na_skrywer.na: Die haas krap die Maan se gesig, en die merke is nog daar.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'krap na' means only clawing at, yet marks remain; 'daardie merke' points back to marks never mentioned; plus the AWS comma between two sentences.
na_skrywer.fout: 'daardie merke' points back to marks the story never mentioned, and the sentence lacks the AWS comma.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but dropping 'na' turns clawing at the face into scratching it, which changes the action inside a traditional story, so the writer must fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: sien die Maan onder in die water lê. Sy dink dit is 'n groot stuk vet vleis wat daar dryf.
vlae.rede: The Moon 'lies at the bottom' of the water but the meat 'floats' there; the two images pull against each other. Not changed, because choosing one would alter the story's picture.

vlae.teks: Sy maak haar bek oop en gryp na die vleis in die water. ... Keer op keer gryp sy na die water en haar pote bly leeg.
vlae.rede: She first grabs with her mouth, then her paws come up empty; possibly intended (she keeps grabbing with her paws), but a reader may see a shift. Left for the writer, since it is what happens in the story.
